newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil premiums steady, diesel supply tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil premiums steady, diesel supply tight.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices firmed on Monday as underlying futures gained and premiums remained firm, traders said.
Nov IPE futures rose $2 to $236.25 on a continuation on Friday's rally, low stock levels and Middle East tension.
Traders said heating oil supplies were abundant but those for diesel remained scarce.
"Fundamentals would suggest steady premiums for diesel, but there's plenty of heating oil around," a trader said.
Prompt cargoes of German winter grade (-7/-22) heating oil were offered at Nov IPE +$7 cif NWE, a trader said. Another valued the product at Nov IPE +5/6.50 cif Hamburg.
Refinery grade heating oil barges were offered unchanged at Nov IPE +$3 and storage grade was offered at Nov IPE +$2.
German winter grade diesel barges were offered at Nov IPE +$35. Intermediate grade (-3/-13) was offered at Nov IPE +$32/33, unchanged from Friday's levels.
